blocks.text: Lafz species biology ka ek buniyadi tasawwur hai. Aam taur par species ki tareef yeh hai: aise afraad ka group jo qudrati halaat mein aapas mein interbreed kar sakein (afzaish kar sakein) aur fertile aulad paida karein, yani aisi aulad jo khud bhi aulad paida kar sake. Ek hi species ke afraad mushtarak khasoosiyat aur genetic banawat rakhte hain, jo unhein doosri species ke afraad se alag karti hai.

Jismani khasoosiyat aur mushabehat dekh kar species pehchaanna kabhi kabhi mushkil ho jata hai, kyunke cryptic species hoti hain: aise jandar jo dekhne mein ek jaise lagte hain lekin genetic taur par alag hote hain. Is masle ke hal ke liye German-American biologist Ernst Mayr ne reproductive isolation ko asal kasauti qaraar diya. Is tasawwur ke mutabiq species aapas mein interbreed karne wali qudrati aabadiyon ke groups hain. Mukhtalif species ke afraad aam taur par ek doosre se mating nahi karte aur na hi zinda, fertile aulad paida karte hain.

blocks.title: Biological species concept
blocks.text: Species aapas mein interbreed karne wali qudrati aabadiyon ka woh group hai jo doosre aise groups se reproductive taur par alag (isolated) ho. Kasauti yeh nahi ke jandar dekhne mein kaise hain, balke yeh ke kya woh aapas mein afzaish kar ke fertile aulad paida karte hain.

blocks.title: Shakal kaafi kyun nahi
blocks.text: Cryptic species ek jaisi dikhti hain lekin genetic taur par alag hoti hain aur aapas mein interbreed nahi kartin. Is ka ulta bhi hota hai: ek species ke afraad bohat mukhtalif dikh sakte hain, jaise kutton ki naslein (dog breeds), phir bhi ek hi species hain kyunke woh aapas mein afzaish kar ke fertile bachay paida karte hain.

Speciation woh evolutionary amal hai jis se ek saanjhe jadd (common ancestor) se nayi species paida hoti hain. Is mein aise genetic tabdeeliyon ka jama hona shamil hai jo aabadiyon ke darmiyan reproductive isolation paida karti hain. Speciation ke kai tareeqe (mechanisms) hain.

Allopatric speciation us waqt hoti hai jab ek aabadi jughrafiyai taur par (geographically) do ya zyada alag groups mein bat jati hai. Yeh groups mukhtalif mahol ka saamna karte hain aur alag alag evolve hote hain. Waqt ke saath jama hone wale farq itne bare ho sakte hain ke interbreeding ruk jaye, chahe baad mein jughrafiyai rukawat hat bhi jaye. Misal: Galapagos jazeeron par Darwin ki finches, jahan mukhtalif aabadiyan mukhtalif mahol ke mutabiq dhal gayin.

Peripatric speciation mein ek bari aabadi ke kinare par ek chhoti, alag-thalag aabadi hoti hai. Yeh chhoti aabadi tezi se evolutionary tabdeeli se guzarti hai aur asal aabadi se alag ho jati hai. Misal: jazeeron ki woh species jo ek chhoti buniyadi (founding) aabadi se evolve hoti hain.

Parapatric speciation us waqt hoti hai jab aabadiyan ek doosre ke saath saath hon lekin kisi gradient ke saath mukhtalif mahol mein rehti hon. Aabadiyon ke darmiyan gene flow (genes ka tabadla) mehdood hota hai, aur har aabadi apne mahol ke mutabiq adaptations evolve karti hai; waqt ke saath is se reproductive isolation ho sakti hai. Misal: ghaas Anthoxanthum odoratum, jo ek gradient par mukhtalif mitti ke halaat ke mutabiq mukhtalif adaptations dikhati hai, jis se mukhtalif mitti par ugne wale podon ke darmiyan reproductive isolation ho jati hai.

Sympatric speciation mein nayi species ek hi jughrafiyai ilaqe ke andar, bina kisi maddi rukawat ke, paida hoti hain. Yeh aksar polyploidy se hoti hai, jis mein jandar ke paas chromosomes ke kai sets hote hain, ya niche differentiation se, jis mein mukhtalif sub-aabadiyan mukhtalif wasail (resources) istemaal karti hain. Misal ke taur par, kuch poday polyploidy se guzarte hain, jis se fauran reproductive isolation ho jati hai aur nayi species ban jati hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar columns, speciation ke har tareeqe ke liye ek, har ek upar se neeche inhi rows se guzarta hai: asal aabadi, pehla qadam, reproductive isolation, speciation. Allopatric: jughrafiyai rukawat aabadi ko baant deti hai. Peripatric: kinare ka chhota group alag niche mein chala jata hai. Parapatric: ek group saath wale niche mein jata hai, mehdood gene flow ke saath. Sympatric: ek sub-group usi ilaqe mein naya niche apna leta hai.
blocks.caption: Speciation ke chaar tareeqe (Figure 1.32 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Har tareeqa ek aabadi se shuru ho kar do species par khatam hota hai, lekin pehla qadam alag hai: jughrafiyai rukawat (allopatric), kinare par alag-thalag chhota group (peripatric), gradient par saath wala niche (parapatric), ya usi ilaqe mein naya niche (sympatric). Har soorat mein reproductive isolation speciation se pehle aati hai.

items: Species aise afraad ka group hai jo qudrat mein aapas mein afzaish kar ke fertile aulad paida karte hain; Ernst Mayr ne reproductive isolation ko asal kasauti banaya.
Cryptic species ek jaisi dikhti hain lekin genetic taur par alag hoti hain, isi liye sirf shakal dhoka de sakti hai.
Speciation saanjhe jadd se nayi species ka paida hona hai, un genetic tabdeeliyon se jo reproductive isolation paida karti hain.
Allopatric: jughrafiyai rukawat. Peripatric: kinare ki chhoti aabadi. Parapatric: gradient par saath wale mahol. Sympatric: ek hi ilaqa, polyploidy ya niche differentiation se.

blocks.prompt: Ek pode ki do aabadiyan tezaabi aur alkaline mitti par saath saath ugti hain aur ab aapas mein interbreed nahi kartin. Yeh speciation ka kaun sa tareeqa hai, aur yeh sympatric speciation se kaise alag hai?
blocks.explanation: Parapatric speciation: aabadiyan mitti ke gradient par saath saath hain aur gene flow mehdood hai, jaise Anthoxanthum odoratum mein. Sympatric speciation ek hi saanjhe ilaqe mein hoti hai jahan koi jughrafiyai alehdagi bilkul nahi hoti, misal ke taur par polyploidy se.
